fluff.overview: The Draconis Combine Mustered Soldiery assigns conventional infantry to garrison roles across its military districts, with district regulars often fielding extra platoons to secure worlds that BattleMech forces cannot permanently garrison. Jump infantry carry jump packs that make them the most mobile troops in the DCMS inventory for urban and broken terrain fighting. The ability to bypass obstacles and seize elevated positions gives these platoons a tactical value that district commanders prize, particularly on heavily built-up garrison worlds where conventional movement is restricted. Their support troops carry man-portable flamers that spray burning chemicals across several hundred square meters. Devastating against infantry in the open and effective at clearing structures, though the short range and the vulnerability of the operator's fuel tank make flamer duty one of the most dangerous assignments in the platoon.
